projects.name: Aether Heights
projects.subtitle: Stone, light & a slower pace
projects.description: An illustrative study in restraint. Warm timber, textured stone and generous glazing bring the landscape into the home. The low roof creates a protected threshold between intimate interiors and the open garden.

image.alt: Low stone pavilion with full height glazing and warm timber details

projects.name: Azure Sanctuary
projects.subtitle: A dialogue between water & sky
projects.description: An illustrative courtyard concept organised around a reflecting pool, exploring the meeting of architecture and horizon. Deep overhangs temper the light while open living spaces follow the rhythm of the water.

image.alt: Contemporary courtyard home beside a long reflecting pool at sunset

projects.name: Summit Pavilion
projects.subtitle: A new perspective on urban living
projects.description: An illustrative vertical home with room to breathe. Layered terraces and planted edges offer privacy while keeping the house connected to its surroundings.

image.alt: Three level white modernist residence with recessed terraces and green planting

arkimade.studioDescription: Considered spaces. A quieter kind of sophistication. Exploring natural light, honest materials, and the pleasure of feeling at home.
arkimade.approachTitle:
A place begins
with a conversation.
arkimade.approachIntro:
Every home is personal.
Our process starts with you.

steps.title: Listen & discover
steps.text: How do you live? What brings you calm? We begin with your everyday rituals, your ambitions, and the character of the site. Together, we define what home should feel like.

steps.title: Explore & refine
steps.text: Ideas take shape through sketches, material studies and spatial exploration. We consider the relationship between light, landscape and each room, refining the design with you.

steps.title: Detail & realise
steps.text: From the broadest gesture to the smallest junction, we bring the design into focus. Careful documentation and collaboration guide a considered vision toward a built home.

arkimaison.approachTitle:
Your home.
Your way of living.
arkimaison.approachIntro:
Good interiors begin with listening.
Our process starts with you.

steps.title: Listen & discover
steps.text: How do you use your space? What makes you feel at home? We start with your everyday routines, your favourite things, and what you want your rooms to become.

steps.title: Explore & refine
steps.text: Layouts, materials, colours, and lighting come together in a clear interior concept. We explore furniture, finishes, and the small details that give your home its character.

steps.title: Detail & realise
steps.text: We refine the joinery, lighting, finishes, and furniture into a cohesive direction. A considered interior brief helps you take the next steps toward bringing your space to life.
